capabilities: publish notes to Yuque with a single command
create or update Yuque documents automatically
configure document visibility (private, public, space members)
support personal and team Yuque accounts with multiple group configurations
set per-note publishing targets via frontmatter
extras: Bilingual README (Chinese and English); token URLs in the README appear blank after link stripping, so token acquisition steps point to removed links.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes to Yuque, a popular Chinese knowledge management platform.
summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to Yuque, creating or updating documents via a command with configurable visibility and multiple account configurations.
